version_notes: v1.1 calibration (2026-08-30): six-item single-batch update — package-cycle graph rule, composition-root fan-out exemption, main-sequence weight reallocation, hotspot + cognitive methodologies, delivery ledger semantics, temporal-coupling qualification parameters — plus pre-registered duplication-rate and core-mutation methodologies. This contract is FROZEN from the moment its sha256 binds evidence until the first formal score; any further methodology issue accumulates for v1.2. Metric targets, floors, ceilings, hard gates, grade cap, and evidence policy are unchanged from v1.

class_loc_max.nesting: every ClassDef is an independent sample, including classes nested in classes, sync functions, and async functions
class_loc_max.boundary: decorator lines and trailing comments are outside the span; nested definitions remain inside their enclosing class span

reverse_dependency_count.imports: absolute Import and ImportFrom nodes at any AST depth; relative imports are not matches for these absolute forbidden prefixes

main_sequence_distance_p90.unit: first two package directories below backend/app, for example domains/kol becomes app.domains.kol; shallower paths use their available directories and root files become app
main_sequence_distance_p90.coupling: Ca and Ce count unique non-self internal unit dependencies from the same complete static import graph
main_sequence_distance_p90.abstractness: A is syntactically abstract ClassDef count divided by all ClassDef count in the unit; no classes means A=0
main_sequence_distance_p90.abstract_class: base terminal ABC/Protocol, metaclass terminal ABCMeta, or direct sync/async method decorator terminal abstractmethod/abstractclassmethod/abstractstaticmethod
main_sequence_distance_p90.zero_denominator: Ca+Ce=0 sets I=0 and retains the unit in the distribution
main_sequence_distance_p90.percentile: nearest-rank p90 at sorted rank ceil(0.90*N)
main_sequence_distance_p90.v1_1_weight_note: 全仓零抽象类语境下 D 口径失真,v1.2 复盘。With zero syntactically abstract classes repository-wide, A=0 for every unit and D=|A+I-1| degenerates to |I-1| (pure instability), so the p90 cannot express the intended abstractness signal. v1.1 therefore reallocates this metric's weight 0.15 -> 0.05 (the released 0.10 goes to cross_core_scc_count +0.05 and module_loc_max +0.05). Formula, unit, target, and ceiling are unchanged; the D methodology itself is revisited in v1.2.

package_cycle_count.graph: same module universe as v1: production Python under backend/app, one graph node per module, Tarjan strongly connected components; a cyclic SCC has size >= 2 or a self-edge
package_cycle_count.edge_rule: an import contributes an edge only when it executes at module import time: Import/ImportFrom nodes whose nearest enclosing lexical scope is the module or a class body — never inside a FunctionDef, AsyncFunctionDef, or Lambda body — and never inside the body of an if-TYPE_CHECKING guard (a test that is the bare name TYPE_CHECKING or an attribute whose terminal segment is TYPE_CHECKING; imports in the orelse branch of such an if still count). Statically resolved importlib.import_module/__import__ edges and implicit parent-package initialization edges follow the same lexical import-time rule; unresolved dynamic imports still mark the graph partial exactly as in v1
package_cycle_count.excluded: TYPE_CHECKING-guarded imports and function-level lazy imports cannot participate in an import-time cycle and are excluded from this count only
package_cycle_count.scope_of_change: this refined edge rule applies to package_cycle_count (and its companion ratchet cyclic_module_count) exclusively; cross_core_scc_count, internal_fan_out_max, and the main-sequence Ca/Ce coupling keep the complete conservative v1 graph with imports at any AST depth, so the cross_core_cycles_zero hard gate is unaffected

internal_fan_out_max.graph: complete conservative v1 import graph (imports at any AST depth), unchanged
internal_fan_out_max.rule: the formal internal_fan_out_max is the maximum unique-target fan-out over modules NOT listed in composition_roots; every exempted module and its fan-out must still be reported in the evidence details
internal_fan_out_max.rationale: a composition root wires the whole application together at startup and violates any fan-out bound by definition; the exemption list is explicit and closed — adding an entry requires a contract revision and a new contract hash

cognitive_le_15_ratio.canonical_text:
Deterministic cognitive-complexity counter for the engineering-health collector.

Methodology ``cognitive1`` (fixed subset in the spirit of Sonar Cognitive
Complexity; this docstring is the canonical contract-v1.1 wording):

Base value is 0 per function. Nested ``def``/``class``/``lambda`` bodies are
excluded from the enclosing function and analysed independently with nesting
depth reset to 0 (nested functions and lambdas receive their own rows).

Structural increments, worth ``+1 + current nesting depth`` at the point of
occurrence:

- ``if`` (the head of a chain only),
- ``for`` / ``async for``,
- ``while``,
- each ``except`` / ``except*`` handler,
- the ternary ``IfExp``.

Flat ``+1`` increments that never receive the nesting penalty:

- each ``elif`` branch and each ``else`` branch of an ``if`` chain (an
  ``else`` whose body is exactly one ``if`` statement is indistinguishable
  from ``elif`` in the Python AST and is treated as ``elif``),
- each boolean-operator run: every ``ast.BoolOp`` node counts 1, which equals
  one increment per operator alternation (``a and b and c`` = 1,
  ``a and b or c`` = 2, ``a and b or c and d`` = 3),
- each additional context manager beyond the first in one
  ``with`` / ``async with`` statement,
- each ``case`` clause of a ``match`` statement (wildcard case included,
  guards are not counted separately, case bodies add no nesting),
- each direct recursive call site: the callee is a bare name equal to the
  enclosing function's name, or ``self.<name>`` / ``cls.<name>`` with that
  name; named functions only — lambdas never count recursion.

Nesting depth: the bodies of ``if``/``elif``/``else``, ``for``/``async for``,
``while``, and ``except`` handlers are one level deeper than their parent;
an ``elif`` continues its chain at the chain's own level. ``with``, ``match``
cases, ``try`` bodies, ``else`` of ``try``, ``finally``, and loop ``else``
clauses do not change depth. ``def``/``class`` reset depth. ``IfExp`` earns
the structural increment but does not itself increase depth.

Not counted at all: sequential statements, ``return``, ``assert``, ``raise``,
``break``/``continue`` (Python has no labeled jump targets), ``try`` itself,
``finally``, ``else`` of ``try``, loop ``else`` clauses, a single-item
``with``, and comprehension generator/filter clauses — although boolean
operator runs, ternaries, and recursive calls inside any of those expressions
still count at the current depth.

Determinism: the value is a pure function of the parsed AST; identical source
bytes always produce identical counts.
cognitive_le_15_ratio.scope: same production function rows as cc_le_10_ratio: production Python under backend/app from the architecture-static collector snapshot; nested functions and lambdas receive independent rows

duplication_rate.scope: production Python under backend/app from the architecture-static collector snapshot (tests, migrations, generated code excluded by construction)
duplication_rate.token_stream: stdlib tokenize per file; every token kind is kept except COMMENT, NL, NEWLINE, INDENT, DEDENT, ENCODING, and ENDMARKER; token identity is the exact (type, string) pair — no identifier, literal, or whitespace normalization (type-1 exact clones only)
duplication_rate.shingle: sliding window of 50 consecutive kept tokens, stride 1, never crossing a file boundary; files with fewer than 50 kept tokens produce no shingles but their tokens stay in the denominator
duplication_rate.duplicate: a shingle is duplicated when its exact token sequence occurs at two or more distinct (file, start-offset) positions corpus-wide; occurrences may overlap and same-file repeats count
duplication_rate.rate: duplication_rate = kept tokens covered by at least one duplicated shingle / total kept tokens in the corpus
duplication_rate.determinism: exact sequence comparison (or a collision-checked cryptographic hash of the serialized shingle); no probabilistic sketching; identical snapshot bytes produce identical rates

core_mutation_score.definition: mutation testing runs against production modules whose repository path starts with one of the listed prefixes; core_mutation_score = killed / (killed + survived) pooled across the whole core scope; timed-out mutants count as killed, suspicious and skipped mutants are excluded from both numerator and denominator
core_mutation_score.runner: mutation runs execute against an isolated database and never against production state; the receipt binds the scored HEAD like the coverage receipt

hotspot.minimum_samples_note: unhealthy_hotspot_count and hotspot_cc_mean carry no minimum_samples: an incomplete history window shrinks sample_count (actual covered days, 0..180) instead of blocking the observed status

temporal_coupling_p95.commit_population: non-merge human commits in the 180-day window anchored at the HEAD committer date, commit inclusion by author date; bot and shared-account identities are excluded after HEAD:.mailmap normalization; the working tree is never an input
temporal_coupling_p95.pair_eligibility: a file participates when it passes the evolution production-source filter (production source suffixes, not a test file, no excluded path part) and maps to at least one canonical core domain
temporal_coupling_p95.percentile_rule: nearest-rank p95 at sorted rank ceil(0.95*N) over QUALIFIED pairs only: a pair qualifies when union_change_commits >= 10 AND cochange_commits >= 3
temporal_coupling_p95.qualification_reason: exclude one-off and low-support 100% pairs from the formal percentile
temporal_coupling_p95.fail_closed: zero qualified pairs yields status unknown with reason insufficient_qualified_pairs; the filter parameters are contract-bound — changing any of them is a contract revision with a new hash, never a silent collector edit

delivery_evidence_methodology.ledger_backfill: forbidden — the ledger is append-only and history before ledger_opened is never backfilled or reconstructed
delivery_evidence_methodology.runbook: docs/vkpi/incidents-ledger-runbook.md (口径 section is this same text; the runbook carries field-level recording discipline)
semantics_zh: 什么算事故:生产环境用户可见的功能失效或数据错误,且需要人工干预恢复。预算闸拦截、限流、单次重试即愈的抖动不算(参照发车失败三判别器口径)。
CFR(change failure rate):某次部署后触发回滚、或 24h 内为其打 hotfix,该部署计 failure;分母 = 窗口内生产部署次数(`post-deploy/` 目录数,去重后)。
MTTR:`resolved_at - detected_at`,分钟;p50/p90 按窗口内已 resolved 的事故算。
空样本语义:窗口内零事故 → MTTR 两项与 SLA 按 at-target 记 observed(无事故是好状态,不是无证据;overdue_critical_count=0 同理)。此语义由合同 v1.1 正式承载。
delivery_evidence_methodology.change_failure_rate: a production deployment counts as a failure when it triggered a rollback, or a hotfix deployment was made for it within 24 hours (ledger field hotfix_of); the denominator is the deduplicated count of production deployments in the 90-day delivery window (runtime/ops/post-deploy/ directories); failure attribution starts at ledger_opened
delivery_evidence_methodology.mttr: resolved_at minus detected_at in minutes; p50/p90 over incidents resolved inside the 90-day delivery window
delivery_evidence_methodology.empty_sample_at_target: a window with zero qualifying incidents records mttr_p50_minutes, mttr_p90_minutes, and p1_p2_sla_rate as observed AT THE CONTRACT TARGET VALUE (reason no_incidents_at_target), and overdue_critical_count as observed 0 — the absence of incidents is a good state, not missing evidence; this semantic requires the ledger_days sample floor below

sample_units.ledger_days: floor of the day-overlap between the 90-day delivery window and the ledger active period starting at ledger_opened 2026-08-30T00:00:00Z; the at-target empty-sample semantics is only trusted once this floor is met
sample_units.production_deployments: deduplicated runtime/ops/post-deploy/ directories inside the 90-day delivery window
sample_units.runs: timed verify.sh executions inside the 30-day build window
sample_units.weeks: calendar weeks of deployment history inside the observation window
sample_units.consecutive_runs: consecutive canonical-gate receipts bound to the scored HEAD

delivery_evidence_methodology.minimum_samples_rationale: v1 gated the incident metrics on 20 production_deployments, a unit unrelated to incidents; v1.1 gates the four ledger metrics on 30 ledger_days so that zero-incident at-target observations are only trusted after a month of live ledger discipline. canonical_gate_pass_rate keeps its own channel (3 consecutive_runs) and is not collector-owned
